correctness.rationale: The full 5x7 signed incidence matrix, weights, orthogonal unit directions, and four projected-volume determinant sums are explicitly defined. The standalone exact integer checker enumerates all 21,35,35,35 five-by-five minors and proves each complete coefficient dictionary. Their exact polynomial combination is VW-PQ=16a²b²c⁴, so the claimed normalized projection ratio equals 1+4abc/(3H) and is strictly above one for all a,b,c>0. At fixed a+b and c the ratio is strictly increasing in ab, forcing a=b; the resulting scalar t=c/a has excess t/[3(t+2)²], uniquely maximized at t=2 with value 1/24. All positivity, equality and boundary statements follow analytically from those identities. The checker was actually executed from check_weighted_theta.py and passed coefficient, polynomial, and rational-instance assertions.

value.rationale: The base theta graph is an extremal seven-generator graphical counterexample to an important zonoid projection inequality. Within its natural pathwise weight moduli, the result classifies the entire two-dimensional positive parameter space: the violation is robust for all positive weights, contrary to plausible sign transitions, and the uniquely sharp extremizer is not the source's equal-weight instance. This is a complete structural deformation and sharp finite-invariant optimization, not a routine reparametrization or a merely marginal numerical improvement; it has clear use for understanding robustness and extremal proportions of the minimal graphical counterexample.
